name: coral reef heads rising from shallow water with foam

answer.evidence: The coral heads form rounded mounds set inside an elliptical pool/foam ring (rows 8-14). The orange mound displays an illuminated upper surface across rows 9-10 transitioning into a shadowed south face on rows 11-13, appropriately rendered in 3/4 perspective.
